name: @cngtn/dsh-cngtn-pond
summary: Native caption buttons follow the theme; right panel floats as the sidebar card.
changes: The three native Windows caption buttons are transparent, because the token the desktop preload forwards to setTitleBarOverlay is transparent.
Sidebar surfaces paint from --dsw-alias-bg-base instead of the now-transparent sidebar token.
Docked right panel shares the sidebar inset, radius, hairline and progressive shadow.
Expanded right panel is the same card, spanning the conversation with a frosted sheet.
Dock pane hairline removed so the card is the only frame.
Card, sheet and stacking are gated on the open state, so hiding the panel clears the chat.
